rule_title: T1027/T1059.001 - Obfuscated PowerShell Execution - Hidden Window with Encoded Command
description: Detects PowerShell launched with the classic obfuscation trifecta: hidden window (-w hidden or -WindowStyle hidden), execution policy bypass (-ep bypass or -ExecutionPolicy Bypass), and a base64 encoded command (-enc or -EncodedCommand). Commonly used as a loader stage.
